Math.round((deployedVehicles / totalVehicles) * 100) : 0 const revenue = data?.totals.revenue || 0 const pendingReviews = (data?.totals.pendingAiApprovals || 0) + (data?.totals.expiredDocuments || 0) + (data?.totals.expiringDocuments || 0) return (
